newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Ships collect Burundi-bound goods after sanctions eased.
newsitem.headline: Ships collect Burundi-bound goods after sanctions eased.

text.p: For the first time since trade sanctions were imposed on Burundi by neighbouring African states last July, three Burundi-registered ships have arrived at the Lake Tanganyika port of Kigoma to load supplies.

Tanzanian port officials said on Sunday the ban on movement of goods had been eased following an African summit meeting earlier this month, which agreed to lift some of the restrictions on humanitarian grounds.
The Sunday Observer newspaper quoted Kigoma port authorities as saying the ships would carry 2,045 tonnes of fertiliser to the Burundi capital, Bujumbura, this week.

Other Burundi-bound goods, including 155,000 tonnes of diesel fuel, are still held up in Kigoma by the trade embargo, which was imposed in protest against last year's military coup in which Pierre Buyoya took power in Burundi.
